projectDescription: A full-stack restaurant management system with POS, kitchen display, customer digital menu, inventory control, supplier directory, and financial reporting — built with React 19 + FastAPI + PostgreSQL and deployable via Docker Compose.
keyFeatures: Point of Sale (POS) with IVA (16%) calculation and printable order tickets
Customer-facing digital menu with self-service ordering and real-time order tracking
Kitchen Display System (KDS) with audio alerts for incoming orders
Multi-field order history search (by cedula, name, ticket, phone)
Inventory management with low-stock visual alerts (stock <= stock_minimo)
Supplier directory with RIF, contact, and company information
Financial reports and KPI dashboard with period-over-period comparison
Automatic database schema creation and seed data on first boot
Supports Mesa, Pickup, and Delivery order types
publicApiSurface: GET /api/ordenes — list all orders (filterable by estatus=activo)
GET /api/ordenes/{num_ticket} — get single order by ticket number
POST /api/ordenes — create new order with client, items, and invoice
DELETE /api/ordenes/{num_ticket} — cancel and delete an order
GET /api/platos — list menu items (filterable by categoria)
POST /api/platos — create a new menu item
GET /api/reportes/resumen — KPI summary (revenue, orders, avg prep time)
GET /api/reportes/pedidos — filtered order report by period and status
